item.title: Ocean Biomes ++ Add-On
item.creator: SandBlock Studios
item.description:
Dive into the Ocean Biomes ++ Add-On and experience a living underwater world. Encounter vibrant sea life and epic bosses as you discover the secret Atlantean technologies hidden beneath.

18 Unique underwater BIOMES
67 New MOBS in different ocean biome
5 VEHICLES, SUBMARINE, GLIDER, JET BOAT, and more
3 BOSS
TOOLS, WEAPONS, ARMORS and utility items

faqEntries.heading: How do I make Empty Oxygen Bottles?
faqEntries.content: Craft an Empty Oxygen Bottle with Iron Ingots and Glass in a crafting table.

faqEntries.heading: How do I fill Oxygen Bottles?
faqEntries.content: Use an Oxygen Extractor with Empty Oxygen Bottles and Oxygen Plant input. The extractor produces filled Oxygen Bottles for deeper dives.

faqEntries.heading: Which vehicle should I use?
faqEntries.content: Use the Jet Boat for surface scouting, the Sea Glider for quick underwater movement and the Submarine for long deep dives.

faqEntries.heading: How do I exit vehicles?
faqEntries.content: Sneak to exit rideable vehicles such as the Jet Boat and Submarine.

faqEntries.heading: Why does fog or visibility change underwater?
faqEntries.content: Fog changes based on your current route, depth and gear mode. Normal suits, advanced suits and the Submarine can use different visibility profiles.

faqEntries.heading: Are there new key bindings?
faqEntries.content: No new custom key bindings are required. The add-on uses vanilla controls such as use/interact, movement and sneak.

item.howToTitle: Create or open a world with the Ocean Biomes ++ Behavior Pack and Resource Pack enabled. When you join, open the Ocean Biomes Guide and read the Branch Map first.  Start in shallow ocean routes and gather basic resources before diving deeper. Collect Oxygen Plants, craft Empty Oxygen Bottles, and use the Oxygen Extractor to prepare filled Oxygen Bottles for longer dives.  Ocean Biomes ++ uses branch-based progression. Stay inside the same surface ocean branch while descending, because lower routes are connected to the branch above them. For example, Coral Reef leads down into Molten Caves and then into Ashen Abyss.  Use the right vehicle for the job. The Jet Boat is best for fast surface travel, the Sea Glider is best for short underwater movement, and the Submarine is best for long deep dives.  Upgrade your gear before entering dangerous routes. Start with the Diving Suit, then progress toward the Advanced Diving Suit or Titanium gear. Bring ranged weapons such as the Harpoon Launcher or Crystal Cannon before fighting bosses.
